'''Jorn''' was an [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] who worked with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When conflict broke out on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seline]] over control of a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[hypergate]], Jorn was called in to provide expertise on the technology.
